description: The driven port NotificationSender (application) type-imports OutboxEntry from OutboxNotificationAdapter (outbound adapter) and returns it from send(); the adapter already imports the port, so the two files form a cycle.

expectedFindings.reason: application > adapters-outbound is not allowed and adapters-outbound > application is: an allowed edge run backwards (a port naming an adapter type).
Two-file import cycle OutboxNotificationAdapter -> NotificationSender -> OutboxNotificationAdapter.
